description: Styrene vapour leaked from a storage tank after a temperature rise during restart following the COVID-19 lockdown; the vapour cloud reached surrounding villages.
rootCause: Inadequate temperature control and inhibitor management in a storage tank during an abnormal (restart) operating condition

description: Hot work permit issued for welding near hydrocracker unit. H2S accumulated in low-lying drain area. Gas not detected as sensor was in maintenance. Weld spark ignited accumulated gas.
rootCause: Hot work permit active simultaneously with H2S accumulation; sensor offline

description: Workers entered confined space (vessel) during shift changeover without proper atmospheric testing. Incoming shift not briefed on CO buildup from previous cleaning operation.
rootCause: Shift changeover communication gap + confined space entry without gas clearance

description: Near-miss: Two permits active simultaneously — electrical isolation in compressor hall and hot work 30 meters away. CH4 leaked from loose fitting, reached hot work area. Automatic shutdown prevented ignition.
rootCause: Simultaneous operations without compound risk assessment; permit system siloed

location: Gas processing plant pump station (representative scenario)
description: Maintenance crew working on pump during planned outage. SCADA system showed process as stable, but field conditions showed H2S accumulation. SCADA sensor calibration was overdue by 3 months.
rootCause: SCADA sensor drift + maintenance activity + inadequate field verification

description: Near-miss: During shift changeover, 4 permits were active simultaneously across two adjacent zones. New shift supervisor not fully briefed. LPG vapor cloud detected 40 minutes into shift by field operator.
rootCause: Multiple active permits + shift change + inadequate handover protocol

description: Petrol leaked during a pipeline-to-tank transfer operation; the vapour cloud ignited and the fire burned for over a week, killing at least 11 people.
rootCause: Loss of containment during transfer with no rapid detection or isolation; ignition of an unconfined vapour cloud

description: A fire broke out in a crude distillation unit; it was brought under control by the refinery fire crew with no injuries reported.
rootCause: Hydrocarbon release in a process unit leading to fire (unit-level investigation)

description: Water entered an MIC storage tank, triggering a runaway reaction; the toxic gas release killed thousands (3,787 per the Madhya Pradesh government's official figure).
rootCause: Multiple safety systems out of service or undersized during a period of reduced maintenance and staffing
regulation: Factories Act Chapter IVA (hazardous processes), Section 41H

description: A worker without a safety helmet was struck by a falling tool during overhead work. CCTV covered the bay but nobody was watching the feed.
rootCause: PPE non-compliance not detected in real time; overhead work without exclusion zone

description: Welding spatter ignited packaging material; smoke was visible on CCTV for several minutes before a supervisor noticed and raised the alarm.
rootCause: Combustibles inside the hot-work radius; no fire watch; visual smoke not auto-detected
